name: dsh-rea
description: Reverse engineering as a surface: five `rea_*` tools over the user's own REA installation (morluto/rea, MIT) - `rea_status` (what is installed, which commands this REA actually offers, which native providers it can reach), `rea_inspect` (one target -> REA's `--json`, stored as an investigation), `rea_read` (a bounded slice of a stored investigation), `rea_snapshot` (list/export/import an investigation so it is reproducible) and `rea_report` (a Markdown evidence report in the workspace). Host-only, argv-only, target-scoped to the session workspace or an explicitly allowed root. Zero npm dependencies, no engine bundled, no network egress of its own.
